title: Practice forgiveness until fear loses its stage
summary: Forgiveness thins fear because the heart stops guarding its injury. Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
takeaway: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
lifeApplication: When the old sentence rises again, release it before it claims the room and choose one softer answer instead of replay.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness thins fear because the heart stops guarding its injury.
source.lifeApplication: When fear is living inside the grudge, release one claim and watch what softens.
